comparison.objective: Wrap pipe threads with thread-seal tape in the fitting direction and return the dispenser.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous deformable tape handling, tensioned winding, tearing, and tail pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Clockwise wrap of 3–6 turns with specified coverage and end clearance, tape torn and tail pressed, dispenser returned and released. Tape damage beyond incorrect coverage is not separately defined.
comparison.reason: Tape winding and controlled tearing are unrelated to rigid granular screening despite both involving coordinated tool handling.
